# fake-clock

> A Clock interface for Go with a real implementation and a manual fake whose timers, tickers and sleeps fire only when a test advances time Go module `github.com/Trysac/u294-fake-clock`, package `fakeclock`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
